skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use terminology related to natural resources in English.
Memorize basic grammatical structures in English.
Understand concepts, meanings, classifications, and importance of natural resources in English.
Understand resource economics, management, and utilization of natural resources globally and in Vietnam in English.
Analyze information related to natural resources economics through listening, speaking, reading, and writing exercises in English.
Compare the efficiency of managing and utilizing natural resources domestically and internationally in English.
Work independently and in groups on selecting topics and solving problems in economics, finance, and business in English.
Develop critical thinking skills through analysis and evaluation of natural resources economics.
Engage in collaborative learning activities in English.
